analysis: post-hoc descriptive comparison of archived and newly executed configurations

scope.excluded_method: AnomalyCLIP_zeroshot_518 (zero-shot; no support set, excluded from variance aggregation)

metric: equal-category macro pixel AP under the archived common-valid-region convention
exclusion: AnomalyCLIP zero-shot has no support set; do not repeat its value to assign zero variance
estimand: observed seed-associated configuration difference; support selection and any seed-dependent implementation randomness are not separately identified
seed_dependent_randomness: PatchCore coreset subsampling is seeded by the support seed (vendored fix_seeds(seed)); other seed-dependent implementation randomness is recorded by each runner but not separately identified from support selection

reuse_policy.archived_units: Seeds 0-1 are fully archived. Seeds 0-4 for mpdd/btad A1 and canonical encodings are reused from archived extensions when byte-identical invariants pass; missing units are executed fresh.
reuse_policy.query_encodings: Seed-varying runs reuse the archived seed-0 query block (max_abs_diff 0.00171, distance-effect ratio 1.55e-05 archived in QUERY_DRIFT.json); seeds 0-1 blocks are never rewritten.
reuse_policy.frozen_archives: No frozen CSV, frozen figure, protocol, or archived unit bytes are modified; all new artifacts land in new directories.
